In my testing it clocked a peak HDR brightness (on a 10% window pattern) of 833 nits and 854 nits in Filmmaker Mode and Standard respectively. Those scores put it in line with the rival LG B6E (which hit 808 nits and 727 nits in the same respective modes), but are much lower than those achieved by the step-up S90H, which measured 1,689 and 1677 in the same two modes.
As for fullscreen brightness, the S85H hit just over 150 nits in both Filmmaker and Standard, which is about right for WOLED, but it’s still a significant drop compared to rival mini-LEDs such as the TCL QM7L/C7L, which hit over 600 nits. This means the S85H can struggle in bright rooms, and without an effective anti-glare coating, dark scenes can be hard to watch in brighter conditions, so this TV is best suited to viewing in ambient or dark conditions. Samsung’s step-up S90H OLED, on the other hand, easily handles bright rooms.
Starting with SDR content, the S85H does a good job of upscaling textures. Watching various programs on Samsung TV Plus, textures did look cleaner and sharpened than you’d get on some standard LED and mini-LED TVs, and with bolder colors. While the step-up S90H did a better job with upscaling, the S85H’s was still impressive nonetheless.
Switching to 4K HDR content, the S85H delivers excellent colors. Watching Elemental on Disney Plus in HDR10+, the bold oranges of the fire people and blues of the water people pop throughout the movie, even in the slightly dimmer Filmmaker Mode. Putting the S85H in Movie mode adds more brightness and a bit more color depth which works well for the animation. As Ember runs across multi-colored minerals, colors have a nice shine to them, showing the S85H’s punchy HDR highlights.
Watching a live-action movie, The Sound of Music, the S85H shows it can render realistic-looking colors too. The green fields and blue skies of Austria look wonderfully natural whenever they’re on screen, and the S85H shows true-to-life skin tones in the people as well.
Measuring the S85H’s HDR color-gamut coverage, it registered 97.9% of the UHDA-P3 and 73.4% of the BT.2020 color spaces. These numbers are about right for a WOLED TV, but are starting to fall behind those of more premium OLEDs and RGB mini-LED TVs. Still the S85H’s colors were great overall.
The S85H also demonstrates strong contrast. In The Batman, which includes lots of scenes with lights cutting through the dark environments, such as in the Batcave and in aerial shots of Gotham, the S85H shows an excellent balance between these light and dark tones to create an authentic image. The same is true in Project Hail Mary, with both shots of space and scenes inside the ship showing the S85H’s powerful contrast and deep black levels.
Shadow detail is also great, with details and textures legible in challenging dark scenes, such as frames on the wall of Mayor Mitchell’s house in The Batman. I did notice during some particularly dark shots that the S85H was prone to some black crush, even in pitch-black viewing conditions. For the most part however, its contrast was impressive.
The S85H also demonstrated crisp textures in nearly every scene I watched, with people in particular looking true-to-life. This 3D-like level of detail was one of the S85H’s strengths over the LG B6E when I tested the two side-by-side, showcasing the effectiveness of the Real Depth Enhancer feature.
Finally, the S85H demonstrated very good motion for both sports and movies, although some setup is required. I found setting blur reduction to 3 and judder reduction between 3-5 (depending on the content and how fluid you want your picture) was the most effective. There were still some motion artefacts when watching a soccer match on Prime Video, with some blurring of textures in some shots, but the S85H was mostly effective.
- Picture quality score: 4.5 / 5
Samsung S85H review: Sound quality
- Great accuracy thanks to OTS Lite system
- Very good detail
- Soundstage and bass can be narrow
The S85H’s two-channel, 20W speaker system isn’t strong enough to allow you to skimp on a soundbar if you want powerful and immersive sound for action-heavy movies and shows, and doesn’t match up to step-up TVs, but is mostly fine for day-to-day viewing and some movies.
Watching the Batmobile scene from The Batman, the S85H’s strength lay in the accuracy of sound, showing how effective the OTS Lite system was. As the Batmobile swerved through traffic, screeching tires and car horns were mapped with real accuracy between the sound and action on the screen.
Impacts also generated some nice punch. As the Batmobile clatters through a barricade, the sound of scraping metal had some weight to it, and as the Batmobile’s engine revved, there was some punchy bass. However, when I pushed the volume, the bass did seem to fizzle out, and high-end sound could be a little harsh.
While I did hear some extension of sound from the frame of the screen, particularly during the aforementioned swerving manoeuvres, the sound felt contained to the rear of the screen, making it feel like the viewing experience was lacking some depth. Speech was mostly clear throughout, but could get lost at times. Again, you want a cinematic experience, I’d hook up a soundbar.
- Sound quality: 3.5 / 5
Samsung S85H review: Design
- Thin frame
- Two-position option for feet (55-inch)
- Lightweight build
The most striking thing visually about the S85H is how thin it is compared to rival TVs in this price range. It has a sleek, metal frame and a razor-thin depth that suggest a more premium price. Even its rear panel is fairly trim, with only a small bump to accommodate the connection ports.
For the 55-inch model I tested, two plastic feet were supplied which, while they felt a little cheap, were very easy to install. You can choose between two positions for the feet, narrow and wide, with the latter being very useful if you have a soundbar. The TV is also very light for a 55-inch model, but still felt sturdy when placed on a TV stand.
The S85H comes with Samsung’s SolarCell remote, which offers solar and USB-C charging. Its small size means it could get lost quite easily, but it feels light in the hand, and offers all the usual options (streaming app shortcuts, settings, power and volume).
- Design score: 4.5 / 5
Samsung S85H review: Smart TV & menus
- Tizen One UI platform
- Good number of picture settings
- Some frustrations with home screen
Samsung’s own Tizen serves as the smart TV platform for the S85H, and with it come a host of AI features via the Vision AI companion, which uses AI agents to help with content recommendation, lifestyle advice, and more general questions you might ask of a smart assistant (how long is a day on Jupiter was one of the example prompts). There are also a host of AI Picture and sound features via the AI Mode settings (found under the Advanced Features menu), such as AI Soccer Mode and Adaptive Sound Pro.
Tizen’s main three hubs on the main screen — For You, Live, and Game and Apps — host recommended content, live TV, gaming content and a general apps page respectively. These pages are generally laid out well, but do have banner ads that take up about a third of the page. I also found Samsung TV Plus autoplays on the For You page and can sometimes take over the page if left idle, which can be frustrating.
You can choose from a good number of picture settings, all housed in logical places within the settings menu. Some of these settings, such as Auto HDR Remastering for SDR content, can be effective. Sound settings are a bit more limited, and I’d have liked more than two sound mode options. Tizen is a solid interface overall, but doesn’t quite match up to LG’s webOS or Roku for ease-of-use.
- Smart TV and menus score: 4 / 5
Samsung S85H review: Gaming
- Four HDMI 2.1 ports
- Ultra-low 9.2ms input lag time
- Game hub
The S85H is an excellent choice for gaming. It has four HDMI 2.1 ports, perfect for multiple consoles, and all of these support 4K 120Hz, full VRR including FreeSync and G-Sync, ALLM and HDR10+ gaming. The featured Game Hub is a useful home for all things gaming, and offers quick access to a connected console and cloud gaming apps.
The S85H’s input lag registered 9.2ms at 4K 60Hz and 4.5ms at 1080p 120Hz, the latter of which is one of the lowest scores I’ve seen. This translates into actual gaming too. Playing Battlefield V, motion felt incredibly smooth with razor-sharp response times — extremely useful when faced with tons of enemies.
Picture-wise, the S85H’s brilliant quality is great for gaming. The colors of autumnal trees during one mission really popped on screen, while textures were very crisp, and, during night-time missions, black tones were deep and contrast was strong.
- Gaming score: 5 / 5
Samsung S85H review: Value
- Great value for money
- Brilliant performance and features
- Rival B6 is cheaper in most places
The 55-inch S85H I tested currently costs $999 / £999 / AU$1,999, which is very good for a budget OLED. Considering the features and performance it delivers, it’s great value for money overall.
Right now, its major rival, the LG B6, is cheaper in most places. A 55-inch LG B6 (or in some cases LG B6E, which isn’t markedly different from the standard B6) costs around $799 / £999 / AU$1,699. The B6 offers near-identical features and performance, so right now it’s the better deal.
The Samsung S90H is a notable step-up over the S85H, offering higher brightness, better picture quality and an anti-reflection screen for bright-room viewing. The 55-inch model costs $1,199 / £1,199 / AU$2,999, so if you’re in the UK and US and can stretch your budget, it’s worth the upgrade. Still, the S85H is good value overall, and I expect its prices will drop and fall more in line with those of the B6 as time goes on.
- Value score: 4.5 / 5
Should you buy the Samsung S85H?
Buy it if...
You want OLED at a more affordable price
If you're looking for an OLED TV but don't want to fork out the big bucks, the S85H is a perfect gateway into the tech. 
You want great picture quality 
The S85H thrives with colorful movies, but also presents strong contrast and crisp textures that highlight what's to love about OLED
You want a gaming TV
Fully kitted out with four HDMI 2.1 ports and every feature you could need and the performance to go with it, the S85H is perfect for gaming. 
Don't buy it if...
You need Dolby Vision
There's no support for Dolby Vision HDR, which is used on a lot of 4K Blu-rays and streaming services. This is the case with all Samsung TVs. 
You want the best sound
The S85H's built-in sound is solid enough for day-to-day viewing, but if you want a more cinematic experience, you'll need a soundbar. 
You can stretch your budget to the Samsung S90H
In some sizes, the step-up Samsung S90H is only a little pricier and its big upgrade over the S85H, with an anti-glare screen and higher brightness. 
Also Consider
| Header Cell - Column 0 | Samsung S85H | LG B6 | Samsung S90H | TCL QM7L/C7L | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Price (55-inch) (current) | $999 / £999 / AU$1,999 | $799 / £899 / AU$1,699 | $1,199 / £1,199 / AU$2995 | $699 / £849 / AU$1,395 | 
| Screen type | OLED | OLED | OLED | SQD mini-LED | 
| Refresh rate | 120Hz | 120Hz | 165Hz | 144Hz | 
| HDR support | Dolby Vision, HDR10, HLG | Dolby Vision, HDR10, HLG | HDR10+, HDR10, HLG | Dolby Vision, HDR10+. HDR10, HLG | 
| Smart TV | Tizen | webOS 26 | Tizen | Google TV | 
| HDMI ports | 4x HDMI 2.1 | 4x HDMI 2.1 | 4 x HDMI 2.1 | 4 (2 x HDMI 2.1) | 
LG B6
The LG B6 is the S85H's closest rival and offers similar performance and features, but for slightly cheaper. The B6 has richer colors and Dolby Vision, while the S85H has crisper textures. Both deliver strong contrast as well, and are full kitted out for gaming. This comes down to whichever model is cheaper. 
Read our full LG B6 review
Samsung S90H
The step-up model from the S85H, the S90H is pricier, but it has an effective anti-glare screen perfect for bright rooms, better picture quality and a better processor. The S90H is worth the investment if you can stretch your budget. 
Read our Samsung S90H review
TCL QM7L/C7L
The TCL QM7L (US)/C7L (UK/Aus) is the brand's mid-range SDQ mini-LED. While the S85H delivers better contrast and textures,  the QM7L/C7L is much brighter and offers competitive gaming features and performance for a similar price. Pick the QM7L/C7L if you have a brighter room. 
Read our TCL QM7L review and TCL C7L review
How I tested the Samsung S85H
- Tested over a couple of weeks
- Testing using SDR and HDR sources in varying lighting conditions
- Measurements taken using Portrait Displays' Calman color calibration software
I first started my testing of the Samsung S85H with casual viewing to assess which picture mode was best, landing on Filmmaker and Movie modes for movies and TV and Standard for sports and broadcast TV.
I then tested the S85H using reference 4K Blu-ray, analyzing its color, contrast, textures and detail and motion, while also using SDR sports and daytime TV to analyze its upscaling capabilities.
Once these tests were complete, I took measurements using a Murido Six G 8K test pattern generator, a Jeti Spectral 15VA spectroradiometer profiled with the a Klein K-10A colorimeter, and recorded the measurements using Portrait Displays' Calman color calibration software.
I tested the S85H's brightness, measuring on a white window pattern in sizes 1-100%, with a focus on 10% peak and 100% fullscreen brightness, in both SDR and HDR.
I then measured its color and grayscale accuracy in SDR using Delta-E averages (the margin for error between the test pattern signal and what's displayed on screen).
Next was HDR color gamut coverage, where I sued the UHDA-P3 (the color space used for 4K Blu-ray and digital cinema releases) and BT.2020 (becoming more commonly used) color spaces.
I also measured the S85H's HDR EOTF, using 1,000, 4,000 and 10,000 nits targets, which shows the TV's accuracy between light and dark tones. I also measured its Spectral Power Distribution, which measures its color performance.
Finally, I measured its input lag in both 4K 60Hz and 1080p 120Hz using a Leo Bodnar 4K HDMI Input Lag Tester.
Read our in-depth overview of how we test TVs at TechRadar.
- First reviewed: November 2026
- Read TechRadar's reviews guarantee
James is the TV Hardware Staff Writer at TechRadar. Before joining the team, he worked at a major UK based AV retailer selling TV and audio equipment, where he was either telling customers the difference between OLED and QLED or being wowed by watching a PS5 run on the LG 65G2. When not writing about the latest TV tech, James can be found gaming, reading, watching rugby or coming up with another idea for a novel.

Black Friday 2026 – La liseuse Amazon Kindle Paperwhite (2024) 16 Go à 144,99 € (-31%)
La liseuse Amazon Kindle Paperwhite (2024) 16 Go passe sous les 150 € chez Boulanger.com soit une baisse d'environ 31% sur le prix habituellement constaté. C'est actuellement l'un des meilleurs produit de notre comparatif.
La sixième génération de la Kindle Paperwhite d’Amazon donne un coup de neuf à l’une des gammes de liseuses les plus populaires du marché. Cette Paperwhite 2024 apporte des améliorations certes mesurées, mais qui peuvent potentiellement avoir un impact important à l’usage. Il est en effet question d’un écran un peu plus grand, une réactivité améliorée et un meilleur contraste.

- Résistance à l'eau IPX8.
Points faibles
- Position du bouton d'alimentation discutable.
- Pas de réglage automatique de la luminosité.
La Kindle Paperwhite de cinquième génération (2021) restait un très bon modèle, même trois ans après sa sortie. Amazon parvient pourtant à l’améliorer encore sur des points aussi fondamentaux pour une liseuse que le rendu de l’écran et la réactivité. Les nouveautés présentes sur la Kindle Paperwhite 2024 ne sont certes pas tapageuses sur le papier, mais il n’en fallait pas plus pour augmenter significativement le confort de lecture. Contrairement à des modèles concurrents qui multiplient les fonctionnalités, celui-ci reste toutefois concentré sur le seul usage de la lecture. Mais cette liseuse s’acquitte de sa tâche à la perfection. Si vous pouvez vous permettre la soixantaine d’euros de surcoût par rapport à une liseuse plus basique telle que la Kindle 2024, vous ne le regretterez pas tant cette Paperwhite 2024 se positionne comme la référence incontournable en milieu de gamme.

articles.title: Truco para crear láminas para colorear de Las Guerreras K-pop y los Saja Boys sin desde el celular o PC
articles.text:
Crear dibujos o láminas para colorear inspirados en Las Guerreras K-pop y los Saja Boys puede resolverse con una instrucción clara en Gemini, la herramienta de inteligencia artificial (IA) de Google.
El proceso está disponible desde el navegador de una computadora o desde la aplicación para celular, siempre que se inicie sesión con una cuenta de Google.
La clave consiste en reunir referencias visuales, pedir una composición en blanco y negro con contornos definidos y revisar el resultado antes de descargarlo. Una descripción precisa permite obtener una lámina con espacios amplios para colorear, sin fondos cargados ni sombras que dificulten la impresión.
Qué referencias visuales hay que reunir antes de empezar
Antes de abrir Gemini, es clave tener a mano imágenes de los dos grupos de la película de Netflix. Las referencias sirven para identificar los peinados, vestuarios, accesorios, poses y elementos que distinguen a cada integrante.
A la par, se debe decidir el tipo de composición. Una opción es pedir a Las Guerreras K-pop a un lado y a los Saja Boys al otro, con una separación central para evitar que las figuras queden amontonadas.
Otra alternativa es elegir una imagen individual, una escena de grupo o personajes sobre un escenario con micrófonos, luces simples y símbolos relacionados con la música.
Cómo acceder a Gemini desde el celular o PC
En un PC, hay que abrir el navegador e ingresar a Gemini. Después de iniciar sesión con la cuenta de Google, la herramienta permite escribir una instrucción en el cuadro de conversación. En la versión web, el apartado de imágenes ofrece plantillas y un espacio para solicitar una creación desde cero.
Desde el celular, se puede usar la aplicación de Gemini para Android o iPhone. El funcionamiento es similar: hay que abrir un nuevo chat, tocar el campo de texto y escribir el pedido.
Si la aplicación o el navegador lo permiten, se pueden adjuntar imágenes de referencia para que la inteligencia artificial tenga una guía sobre la apariencia de los personajes y el tipo de encuadre buscado.
Qué prompt permite pedir una lámina para colorear de Las Guerreras K-pop
El prompt debe comenzar con una orden directa y explicar qué personajes aparecerán, cómo se distribuirán y cuál será el estilo gráfico. Google sugiere incluir el tipo de imagen, el sujeto, la acción y el fondo. Para este caso, conviene aclarar que se busca una ilustración lineal y apta para colorear.
Un ejemplo para copiar y adaptar es el siguiente: “Crea una lámina para colorear en blanco y negro de Las Guerreras K-pop y los Saja Boys. Muestra a los dos grupos en lados opuestos de la imagen, con poses de estrellas de pop y expresiones amigables. Usa líneas negras limpias, contornos gruesos, espacios amplios para colorear, sin sombras, sin colores, sin texto y con un fondo simple de escenario musical. Formato horizontal, estilo de libro para colorear infantil”.
Cómo se corrigen los errores de la primera imagen generada con IA
La primera versión puede incluir problemas habituales, como manos con proporciones extrañas, muchos accesorios, fondos saturados o personajes que no respetan la distribución solicitada.
En vez de comenzar desde cero, se puede responder en el mismo chat con correcciones concretas. La precisión ayuda más que una indicación general como “hazlo mejor”.
Se puede escribir: “Conserva la composición, pero elimina los detalles pequeños del fondo, separa más a los personajes y simplifica los peinados para que sea fácil colorearlos”.
Si una figura quedó muy cerca del borde, conviene pedir que la centre. Es útil solicitar “líneas más gruesas”, “menos sombras” o “contornos cerrados”, según el inconveniente detectado.
De qué forma se prepara el resultado para imprimir o compartir
Cuando la imagen esté lista, hay que abrirla en tamaño completo y revisar que los trazos sean nítidos. La lámina debe tener un fondo blanco, líneas negras visibles y zonas cerradas que permitan colorear sin confusión.
Si se imprimirá en una hoja común, el formato vertical suele funcionar mejor para un personaje individual, mientras que el horizontal ofrece más espacio para una escena grupal.

articles.title: Et maintenant, Amazon voudrait recenser presque tout ce qui se vend en ligne pour contrer les agents IA
articles.text:
Dans un document interne d’Amazon, un client imaginaire se réjouit de ne plus passer une heure sur Reddit avant d’acheter. Selon Reuters, l’entreprise prévoit de rassembler les informations de presque tous les produits vendus sur Terre, y compris ceux qu’elle ne propose pas dans sa boutique.
Avec World Product Graph, Amazon recenserait chaque article en vente dans le monde, que l’entreprise l’ait en stock ou non, et les liens entre ces produits. Pour savoir quel aspirateur ou quelle tablette choisir, vous passez sans doute par les sites des marques, les comparatifs et les forums. « Amazon ne peut pas devenir la plateforme incontournable pour tous les achats si les clients doivent se rendre sur Google, les sites web des marques et les sites d’avis pour se renseigner sur les produits », admettent les auteurs de cette note interne.
Et selon des proches du dossier interrogés par Reuters, Amazon pourrait ainsi attirer sur Amazon.com les agents IA chargés de faire les achats des internautes, au détriment des autres sites marchands.
Amazon veut corriger les erreurs de son assistant d’achat
Comme l’explique Robert Tekiela, le vice-président d’Amazon chargé du catalogue, dans le document, « ce qui manquait, c’était la compréhension », c’est-à-dire savoir comment les produits sont liés entre eux et lequel convient le mieux à chacun. Amazon donne l’exemple de la couleur la plus récente d’une tablette, ou du modèle d’aspirateur qui conviendrait le mieux à un client d’après ses achats passés.
Aux États-Unis, Amazon a remplacé en mai Rufus, son premier assistant d’achat dopé à l’IA, par Alexa for Shopping. Selon le document, les clients lancent environ 83 millions de recherches par semaine avec l’assistant, et chacune coûte cher à Amazon. « De nombreuses réponses de Rufus sont factuellement erronées ou incomplètes, mais les clients n’ont pas les compétences nécessaires pour détecter ces erreurs », reconnaissent ses auteurs. Avec des données plus complètes, l’entreprise pourrait faire tourner son assistant sur des modèles d’IA moins chers. Dans sa réponse à Reuters, Amazon assure que ces chiffres d’utilisation sont « largement obsolètes », et que son assistant donne une réponse exacte dans environ 97 % des cas.
Pour remplir sa base, Amazon compte recevoir en continu les données produits de certaines marques et de certains distributeurs, et explorer sans leur concours les sites d’autres revendeurs. Reuters n’a pas pu savoir s’il demanderait chaque fois leur autorisation. L’entreprise a obtenu l’aide de Coca-Cola et de Bayer, entre autres, pour collecter ces données, et a mené un essai avec Procter & Gamble, à l’occasion duquel les PDG des deux groupes se sont réunis.
- Intégration directe avec Amazon
- Gestion centralisée des produits
- Synchronisation automatique des stocks
Amazon veut ramener vers sa boutique les agents IA de ses concurrents
Lors de la présentation de ses résultats trimestriels, Andy Jassy, le P.-D.G d’Amazon, a minimisé la menace. « Peu de clients font encore beaucoup d’achats de cette manière », a-t-il assuré, et selon lui, ces agents ont très peu affecté la publicité d’Amazon. Mais d’après des proches du dossier, ses dirigeants se méfient de ces agents, qui pourraient envoyer les clients vers d’autres sites, mieux renseignés.
Plus de 10 millions d’Américains et de Canadiens utilisent Muse, l’agent IA de Meta, lancé en septembre, et Amazon lui a fermé sa boutique moins de deux semaines plus tard. Le distributeur poursuit toujours Perplexity en justice pour empêcher son navigateur Comet d’acheter sur Amazon.com. « Peut-être devrions-nous lancer un concurrent à Amazon », a répondu Elon Musk sur X, en réaction à un article sur le blocage de Grok, l’agent de xAI, par Amazon.
Selon des salariés interrogés par Reuters, World Product Graph serait la première étape d’un guichet unique, dans la lignée de Buy for Me et de Shop Direct. Avec ces deux services, Amazon affiche des produits vendus sur d’autres sites et sert d’intermédiaire pour les acheter. Et en gardant les acheteurs et leurs agents sur Amazon.com, l’entreprise protégerait sa publicité, en pleine croissance.
Dans ce document rédigé à la manière d’un communiqué de presse, les équipes d’Amazon ont inscrit une date de lancement indicative, le 1er octobre 2027. Mais « l’existence d’un document de réflexion comme celui-ci ne reflète pas nécessairement nos plans actuels », prévient Amazon.

articles.title: How to watch Spain vs England: FREE live streams, TV channels & kick-off time for Nations League 2026/27 fixture, team news
articles.text:
How to watch Spain vs England: FREE live streams, TV channels & kick-off time for Nations League 2026/27 fixture, team news
Top spot in Group A3, and a home second-leg quarter-final, are up for grabs in Madrid
Find out how to watch Spain vs England for free from anywhere in the world as top spot in Nations League 2026/27 Group A3 is decided at the Metropolitano, Madrid, in a rerun of the Euro 2024 final.
Luis de la Fuente's world champions look unbeatable right now. La Roja made it five Nations League wins from five on Thursday night with a routine 2-0 victory over Czechia to extend their unbeaten run to 43 games. Spain didn't even need Lamine Yamal in that one, but the teenage winger should be back with top spot on the line after scoring in the 3-2 win at Wembley that kicked off the tournament. Mikel Oyarzabal is also in line to return.
England have done all they can since that opening defeat, winning four from four thanks to a scrappy 2-1 against Croatia on Thursday. articles.title: Criptomonedas: cuál es la cotización de Bitcoin este domingo
articles.text:
El bitcoin fue la primera criptomoneda que salió al mercado. Ideada por Satoshi Nakamoto en 2008, esta divisa digital promovía un ideal libertario y buscaba poner en jaque a las instituciones monetarias y financieras tradicionales luego de la crisis financiera mundial que se vivió ese año.
La victoria electoral de Donald Trump significó un movimiento positivo para las principales criptomonedas del mercado. A finales de 2024, bitcoin registró un nuevo máximo histórico que logró superar los 107.000 dólares por unidad, después de que el presidente estadounidense reiteró su idea de crear una reserva estratégica de la criptodivisa en Estados Unidos.
Las divisas digitales serán un foco de atención durante este año, las iniciativas del presidente de Estados Unidos y el desarrollo de nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial fungirán un papel importante en la cotización de estos activos. Después del lanzamiento del nuevo modelo de IA chino DeepSeek, BTC y otras criptos cayeron en la mayoría de los mercados de valores.
Valor de la criptomoneda Bitcoin
La cotización de bitcoin para este día a las 14:00 horas (UTC) es de 65567.98 dólares, lo que significa que la criptomoneda registró un cambio de -1.75% en las últimas 24 horas.
Por otro lado, registró un cambio de 0.0% con respecto a su valor hace una hora. En cuanto a su popularidad, se ubica en la posición #1.
Bitcoin alcanza un nuevo récord y lidera el auge en el mercado de las criptomonedas
En marzo del año pasado el bitcoin ha logrado un nuevo máximo histórico, superando los valores anteriores y reafirmándose como la criptomoneda más importante en el mercado, acercándose a los 73 mil dólares. Este récord se obtuvo en medio de un flujo sin precedentes de inversiones hacia las criptomonedas, un acontecimiento notable para el sector financiero digital.
El aumento en el valor de bitcoin ocurre en un contexto donde hay un entrante masivo de capital hacia las criptomonedas, lo que indica un creciente interés y confianza de los inversores en estos activos. La subida del precio beneficia no solo a bitcoin sino que también tiene un impacto positivo en el mercado de las criptomonedas en general, favoreciendo una mayor estabilidad y visibilidad, de acuerdo a un análisis de Bloomberg.
Expertos financiaron este aumento a diferentes factores, como la adopción institucional de las criptomonedas, la búsqueda de alternativas de inversión debido a la incertidumbre económica mundial y la innovación continua en la tecnología blockchain que respalda a bitcoin y otras divisas digitales. Esta combinación de factores ha creado un entorno propicio para el crecimiento continuo en el valor de Bitcoin.
Cómo adquirir criptomonedas
Para comprarlas e intercambiarlas se utilizan portales especializados. Su valor varía en función de la oferta, de la demanda y del compromiso de los usuarios, por lo que puede cambiar más rápido que el dinero tradicional, pero mientras más gente esté interesada y quiera comprar determinada divisa, mayor será su valor.
No obstante, quien invierte en este tipo de monedas digitales debe tener muy claro que esta forma trae consigo un elevado riesgo al capital, pues, así como puede haber un incremento, también puede tener inesperadamente un desplome y acabar con los ahorros de sus usuarios.
Para almacenarlas, los usuarios deben contar con un monedero digital o wallet, que en realidad es un software a través del cual es posible guardar, enviar y hacer transacciones de las criptomonedas. En realidad, este tipo de monederos sólo guarda las claves que marcan la propiedad y el derecho de una persona sobre cierta criptomoneda, por lo que estos códigos son los que en realidad se deben proteger.

articles.title: Les signalements de contenus pédocriminels liés à l’IA ont bondi de 8 400 % en deux ans
articles.text:
En 2023, les entreprises de la tech ont signalé environ 4 700 contenus pédocriminels liés à l’intelligence artificielle à l’organisme américain chargé de les recenser. En 2025, elles ont transmis plus de 400 000 signalements de ce type.
Childlight, un institut de recherche sur la sécurité des enfants installé à Édimbourg, a relevé ces chiffres dans les signalements reçus par le National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC), et calcule une hausse de plus de 8 400 % en deux ans. Ce total inclut les deepfakes fabriqués avec des applications de « nudification ». Avec ces outils, n’importe qui peut obtenir, à partir d’une photo d’une personne habillée, une image où elle apparaît nue. Ces images sont fausses, mais des maîtres chanteurs peuvent les utiliser pour exiger de l’argent ou d’autres photos aux enfants représentés.
Des photos ordinaires d’enfants transformées en images pédocriminelles
Au Royaume-Uni, les analystes de l’Internet Watch Foundation (IWF), l’ONG qui surveille les contenus pédocriminels dans le monde entier, observent aussi cette progression. Ils ont examiné 6 310 images générées par IA au premier semestre 2026, toutes conformes à la définition légale des abus sexuels sur mineurs. C’est 40 % de plus que sur l’ensemble de l’année 2025.
Pour fabriquer ces images, un criminel n’a plus besoin d’approcher un enfant. Une photo de votre fils ou de votre fille publiée sur un compte Instagram ouvert, sur le site de son école ou sur la page de son club de sport peut servir de point de départ, et les autorités britanniques et l’IWF demandent aux parents de ne plus exposer publiquement les photos de leurs enfants.
Des assistants grand public ont aussi servi à produire ces montages. Début 2026, des internautes ont demandé à Grok, l’IA d’Elon Musk, de dénuder sur X des photos de femmes, parfois mineures, avant que xAI se décide à empêcher son assistant de déshabiller des personnes réelles. Si votre enfant reçoit ce type de chantage, vous pouvez trouver de l’aide au 3018, le numéro national contre le cyberharcèlement.
Childlight demande aux gouvernements de reconnaître une urgence de santé publique
Une meilleure détection et de meilleurs signalements expliquent en partie cette hausse, reconnaît Debi Fry, directrice mondiale des données de Childlight. Mais, comme l’explique la chercheuse, « la rapidité avec laquelle l’intelligence artificielle modifie la menace qui pèse sur les enfants est profondément préoccupante ».
La nouvelle édition de l’indice Into the Light, consacrée à l’Asie de l’Est et au Pacifique, à l’Amérique latine et aux Caraïbes, et à l’Amérique du Nord, mesure aussi les autres formes d’abus. Les précédentes portaient sur l’Europe occidentale. Selon Childlight, plus de 300 millions d’enfants dans le monde subissent chaque année au moins une forme d’exploitation ou d’abus sexuel facilité par la technologie, et un enfant sur quatre sera victime d’au moins une forme d’abus avant ses 18 ans.
L’institut a aussi étudié les violences commises hors ligne. En Amérique du Nord, près d’un tiers des filles et plus d’un garçon sur dix ont subi une agression sexuelle en personne pendant leur enfance. Aux États-Unis, le taux de signalements de contenus pédocriminels a augmenté de 63 % entre 2024 et 2025, contre 18 % au Canada.
« Il est impossible de prévenir efficacement les abus ou de protéger les enfants sans en comprendre l’ampleur et la nature réelles », déplore Paul Stanfield, directeur général de Childlight. L’institut demande aux gouvernements de reconnaître dans l’exploitation sexuelle des enfants une « urgence de santé publique évitable », et d’investir dans des données plus fiables.

articles.title: The iconic Herman Miller Aeron office chair gets a $482 discount in the Black Friday sale
articles.text:
The iconic Herman Miller Aeron office chair gets a $482 discount in the Black Friday sale
It’s an office icon with premium materials and a 12-year warranty, and now the Herman Miller Aeron is 25% cheaper
The Herman Miller Aeron just got a little cheaper - thanks to the Black Friday sale, this famous office chair is currently available at a starting price of $1,331.25, which is a saving of $443.75 on its usual price of $1,775.
That’s still a huge amount of money, but it’s a premium chair designed for years of daily use - and the Aeron has a reputation for exceptional build quality and ergonomic engineering that few office chairs can match.
Today’s best Herman Miller Aeron Black Friday deal
The Aeron is available directly from Herman Miller, with a wide range of specification options.
So while this deal may start at $1,331.25, that’s for a basic model without adjustable armrests, advanced back support, or tilting.
The Aeron is available in ten different finishes and three sizes, with a variety of lumbar support options, and with different arm and caster variations. The good news is that everything is 25% off, so you’ll save a solid chunk of cash no matter what configuration you choose.
Why we recommend the Herman Miller Aeron
The Aeron’s most distinctive feature is its 8Z Pellicle suspension material, which replaces conventional foam cushioning with a breathable mesh seat and backrest. It’s got eight tension zones that effectively distribute weight evenly across the chair alongside a PostureFit SL system that delivers targeted support for your lumbar region.
We reviewed the closely related Aeron Gaming Chair and were particularly impressed by its impeccable build quality and premium adjustment features - and the fact that it arrived fully assembled, with no building required.
Our reviewer found it supermely comfortable, though they noted that the lack of a headrest and a slightly limited array of armrest options were minor drawbacks.
Read our full Herman Miller Aeron Gaming Chair review here.
Price context and historical value
Black Friday prices start at $1,331.25 and rise to more than $2,000 if you configure with Aeron with its full array of adjustment options. So, no matter how you spec up this chair, it’s a significant investment even with the current 25% discount.
However, remember that Herman Miller’s chair isn’t competing with ordinary budget or mid-range office or gaming chairs. It’s got world-class build quality and design, specialist suspension material, a 12-year warranty, and it arrives fully assembled.
It’s a long-term purchase - almost an investment - rather than something you may have to replace after a couple of years.
If you spend most of your day sitting and want to prioritise design quality and comfort, then the Black Friday discount makes this expensive unit a little easier to justify.
Should you buy it?
✅ Buy the Herman Miller Aeron if… you want exceptional build quality, breathable suspension seating and carefully engineered ergonomic support. It’s particularly appealing if you’re investing in a long-term office setup.
❌ Skip the Herman Miller Aeron if… you want a headrest, plush cushioning or a more relaxed seating position. Its distinctive ergonomic design won’t suit everyone, and even discounted, it’s considerably more expensive than most alternatives.

articles.title: Cuánto cuesta la criptomoneda ethereum este domingo
articles.text:
Ethereum es una plataforma digital que adopta la tecnología de cadena de bloques (blockchain) y expande su uso a una gran variedad de aplicaciones, mientras que ether es su criptomoneda nativa. En el mundo de las finanzas digitales es común que la criptomoneda sea llamada como la red, aunque en realidad no son lo mismo.
La plataforma ethereum, creada en el 2015 por el programador Vitalik Buterin, buscaba ser un instrumento para aplicaciones descentralizadas y colaborativas sobre las que se pueden hacer contratos inteligentes (dAPPs)
Al igual que el bitcoin, el valor de ether se disparó en un corto periodo de tiempo. En enero de 2016, ether cotizaba alrededor de un dólar y actualmente tiene un máximo histórico de 4.953,73 dólares.
Mientras el debate se acalora cada día más sobre la conveniencia o no de su uso, ethereum cotiza este día a las 14:05 horas (UTC) en 1830.31 dólares, lo que supone un cambio de -3.79 % con respecto a las últimas 24 horas y una variación de 0.0 % con referencia a su valor alcanzado en la última hora.
En cuanto a su popularidad de mercado, ha mantenido el puesto #2 entre las monedas digitales.
Cotización de la criptomoneda Ethereum
Ethereum y su última actualización
Tras varios meses de retraso y con el temor de que ya nunca pasaría, finalmente el 15 de septiembre de 2022 Ethereum llevó a cabo su tan ansiada fusión o actualización al nuevo nivel 2.0 con la promesa de mejorar la experiencia de los usuarios de esta criptomoneda.
“The Merge”, inglés para “La Fusión”, es una transformación en la forma en que Ethereum procesa las transacciones y en cómo se crean nuevos tokens de Ether.
Esta fusión se trata de la combinación de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum con una nueva cadena de bloques separada conocido como proof-of-stake, el cual reduce el consumo de energía de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum en un 99,9 %, según sus propios desarrolladores, lo que la vuelve más “amigable” con el ambiente al tiempo que las transacciones serían más baratas.
Sus defensores creen que la fusión hará que Ethereum resulte favorecido con respecto al máximo rival, Bitcoin, pues podría aumentar su uso.
En el proceso Proof Stake los propietarios de Ether bloquearán cantidades establecidas de sus criptomonedas para verificar nuevos registros en la cadena de bloques, ganando nuevas monedas además de su criptografía “participada”.

articles.title: Aspirer, laver les sols et nettoyer les vitres : Ecovacs réduit ses robots jusqu’à 800 €
articles.text:
Aspirer, laver les sols ou nettoyer les vitres : Ecovacs veut automatiser toujours plus de tâches ménagères, et profite du Black Friday pour faire baisser le prix de trois de ses robots. Du 9 au 30 novembre, jusqu’au Cyber Monday, les remises atteignent jusqu’à 800 € selon les modèles.
Nous serons sans doute d'accord, le ménage n'est clairement pas l'activité préférée de tout le monde. Pour celles et ceux qui souhaitent automatiser le nettoyage des sols comme celui des vitres, Ecovacs met en avant trois appareils dédiés, avec des remises pouvant atteindre 800 € à l’occasion de ses offres Black Friday.
DEEBOT T90 MAX PRO : un robot aspirateur-laveur qui ne fait pas les choses à moitié
Le DEEBOT T90 MAX PRO mise sur une fiche technique musclée pour assurer aussi bien l'aspiration que le lavage des sols. Il embarque notamment une puissance d'aspiration de 40 000 Pa, associée à la technologie OZMO ROLLER 3.0, qui nettoie le rouleau en continu avec de l'eau propre tout en collectant l'eau sale au cours du processus de nettoyage.
Son rouleau de 27 cm exerce une pression de 4 000 Pa et tourne à 260 tours par minute. Son rinçage en continu est assuré par 32 jets d'eau, afin de limiter la propagation des saletés pendant le nettoyage. Son capteur LiDAR dToF cartographie précisément les pièces et optimise les trajets, tandis que TrueDetect 3D lui permet d'éviter câbles, chaussons et autres obstacles du quotidien.
Le robot peut aussi s'approcher des plinthes et des meubles grâce à la technologie TruEdge 3.0 (qui permet au rouleau à coussin d'air de se rapprocher des bords et des murs de 1,5 cm supplémentaire), tandis que son système ZeroTangle 4.0 limite les enchevêtrements de cheveux et de poils dans la brosse principale. De quoi réduire les interventions manuelles, notamment dans les foyers où les animaux de compagnie laissent régulièrement quelques souvenirs de leur passage.
Une fois sa mission terminée, le DEEBOT retourne à sa station OMNI, qui prend en charge plusieurs opérations d'entretien, dont l’indispensable lavage du rouleau à l'eau chaude à 100 °C. Le robot peut ainsi repartir pour un nouveau cycle sans réclamer une attention permanente.
Du 9 au 30 novembre 2026, le DEEBOT T90 MAX PRO passe de 599 à 449 €, soit 150 € de remise.
DEEBOT X12S OMNICYCLONE Care Kit : une station sans sac et une aspiration de 53 AW
Avec le DEEBOT X12S OMNICYCLONE Care Kit, Ecovacs propose une solution encore plus complète. Ce modèle reprend le rouleau OZMO ROLLER 3.0, avec ses 32 jets de rinçage, sa pression de 4 000 Pa et sa vitesse de rotation de 260 tours par minute. Il y ajoute une aspiration BLAST annoncée à 53 AW, soit une puissance supérieure de 60 % à celle de la génération précédente.
Le X12S dispose également de la technologie FocusJet, qui vient pré-pulvériser les taches tenaces pour les décoller avant le passage du rouleau. Son système AIVI 3D 4.0 lui permet par ailleurs de repérer les obstacles, notamment les câbles et les animaux, tout en adaptant sa trajectoire pour nettoyer au plus près des meubles. Il peut franchir des seuils jusqu'à 2,5 cm et des obstacles successifs atteignant 5 cm au total.
Mais sa particularité se trouve aussi dans sa station OmniCyclone, puisque celle-ci intègre le système PureCyclone 2.0, qui permet de vider automatiquement le bac à poussière sans sac jetable. Un choix qui limite les consommables à remplacer et simplifie encore plus l'entretien au quotidien. 
Cette version “Care Kit” vient ajouter trois filtres antibactériens, deux brosses latérales anti-enchevêtrement et une brosse principale supplémentaire.
Du 9 au 30 novembre, le DEEBOT X12S OMNICYCLONE Care Kit est proposé à 899 € au lieu de 1 299 €, soit 400 € d'économie.
WINBOT W3 OMNI : et si le nettoyage des vitres devenait lui aussi automatique ?
Les sols ne sont pas les seules surfaces à réclamer un peu d'huile de coude. Ecovacs s'attaque aussi aux vitres avec le WINBOT W3 OMNI, un robot lave-vitres accompagné d'une station multifonction qui automatise une partie de son entretien.
Le WINBOT W3 OMNI dispose de plusieurs modes de nettoyage, dont des options rapide, en profondeur ou ciblée. Il peut fonctionner sur secteur ou sur batterie, avec jusqu'à 130 minutes d'autonomie annoncées. Un câble composite associe alimentation et sécurité, tandis que le système de protection en 12 étapes contribue à sécuriser son utilisation sur les surfaces vitrées.
De son côté, la station propose un système Vortex Wash qui nettoie automatiquement les patins, sans qu'il soit nécessaire de les manipuler ou de les laver à la main. Seize jets haute pression et quatre disques de brossage se chargent de retirer les saletés en une minute environ.
A l’instar de ses cousins dédiés au lavage des sols, le Winbot W3 Omni bénéficie lui aussi de la technologie TruEdge, qui lui permet de nettoyer au plus près des bords et des angles, ainsi que de la navigation WIN-SLAM 5.0 pour organiser ses déplacements et éviter les obstacles.
Du 9 au 30 novembre 2026, le WINBOT W3 OMNI passe de 699 à 499 €, soit 200 € de remise.

articles.title: ‘These aren’t just any earbuds, they’re FlyBuds’: Tribit’s super-cheap buds offer great audio for the money, but this one disappointing issue means I can’t recommend them
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The Tribit FlyBuds C3 are a good set of wireless earbuds, with impressive sound quality for the money, strong EQ options, and a comfortable fit. However, their underwhelming battery life and plasticky build slightly hold them back. And while they’re temptingly cheap, their limited ANC is the one thing that stops me from recommending them over similarly priced rivals.
Reasons to buy
- + Good sound quality with powerful bass
- + Highly customizable EQ
- + Compact, comfortable design
Reasons to avoid
- - ANC is light touch
- - Underwhelming battery life
- - Plasticky build
Why you can trust TechRadar
We spend hours testing every product or service we review, so you can be sure you're buying the best. Find out more about how we test.
Tribit FlyBuds C3 review
These aren’t just any earbuds, they’re FlyBuds. And the new Tribit FlyBuds 3 look mighty impressive at a glance, especially when you consider their temptingly low price tag.
The Tribit FlyBuds 3 bring active noise cancellation, highly customizable EQ, and a six-microphone system for 'clear' voice calls. Sounds pretty good for $39.99 / £49.99 (about AU$60), right? But just how good are the FlyBuds C3? I’ve been using them for a couple of weeks now, and this is my verdict.
First up, let’s talk about features. The Tribit FlyBuds C3 offer a lot of the functionality you’d expect from the best wireless earbuds.
Perhaps the main thing is ANC, which has five levels of strength, and can apparently block sounds “up to 45dB”. I have to say, though, that ANC on the FlyBuds C3 is disappointing. On walks, the sounds of nearby chatter and vehicles passing by were dulled, but still pretty audible. And when working in the office, the noise of typing was still pretty clear, even with my music at about 70% volume.
Again, the ANC here will certainly dull your surroundings, but it won’t block them out entirely. With that said, there is a very effective ambient mode that helps you stay aware of your environment when listening to tunes or taking phone calls on the go.
Most of the other features here did impress me, though. You get pretty detailed EQ options, with a number of presets for specific genres and use cases, as well as a full 10-band equalizer if you’re looking for more granular control. In addition, there’s a low-latency game mode, multi-point connectivity, and a hearing protection option.
Something else I appreciated about the FlyBuds C3 was their inclusion of customizable touch controls. By disabling single touch commands, and mapping playback controls to double taps (as well as ANC alterations to press and hold), I was able to avoid accidentally triggering unwanted button presses. You can map specific controls to each individual bud too, which is a great touch.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
I also found the mic quality here to be plenty good enough. When taking phone calls and making a recording, I found that my speech was replicated accurately — I didn’t have to put up with the almost ‘underwater’ quality that some cheap models can apply. I picked up a bit of sibilance, and the microphones’ ability to carve out background noise was pretty limited, but in my view the call quality here is adequate for the price.
There are a few areas that could be improved, though. The X-3D spatial mode just makes music sound louder and less refined, there’s no wear detection or higher-res audio codec support, and the battery life here is surprisingly average.
Yes, you get just five hours from the buds with ANC active and seven hours without noise cancelling on, with up to 35 hours of playtime available with the case (with ANC off). A lot of Tribit’s budget audio tech goes big on battery, so I was expecting more here — that five hours with ANC on is especially weak when you consider you’ll need to use the standard EQ and keep volume at 50% or less to achieve it.
The FlyBuds C3 have been a bit of a mixed bag so far, but how do they fare when it comes to sound quality?
Let’s make a few things clear, though. These earbuds aren’t going to provide a wide, nuanced soundstage, impeccable detailing, or expert instrument separation. They can’t provide the quality that a pair of wired earbuds in this price-range, like the Sennheiser CX 80U can open up, for example, and keep things pretty basic. But you know what, they actually get those basics pretty spot on.
They definitely emphasize the bass first, but this works to good effect. When tuning into Right Before My Eyes by N'n'G, the pounding low end hit with impressive depth and agility, without sounding muddy or unregimented. Vocals in the midrange weren’t particularly open or detailed, but they were relatively clear, and drums in the treble was articulate and snappy.
When listening to the 2020 remaster of Giant Steps by John Coltrane, I felt that instruments in the midrange sounded a touch recessed, but by giving them a bump with some EQ tweaks, they sounded clean and fairly expressive, and the keys were well-separated from the leading sax.
Overall, the FlyBuds C3 provide good sound for their price. Treble can get a little edgy at the higher volumes, and the mid-range needs a bit of tweaking to sound its best, but the powerful bass really shines here.
In terms of design, the FlyBuds C3 keep it pretty simple, and that’s no bad thing. The earbuds themselves are small and lightweight, and are housed in a curved, ultra-compact charging case, making them perfect for sliding into your pocket. While the buds do have a plasticky and cheap-looking appearance, this can be forgiven for the price, and they do look curved and fairly stylish in-use, whether you go for the black or white color variant.
You also get small, medium, and large ear tips in the box, enabling you to find the perfect fit. For me, the medium ear tips were spot on, and I found the C3 to be very comfortable in use, with no signs of fatigue after a full day’s use. IP55 waterproofing also makes these safe to use when working out or listening in light rain.
The Tribit FlyBuds C3 sound pretty solid for the price, offer decent comfort, and have pretty generous EQ options. However, the models I’ve added in the ‘also consider’ section — the Nothing Ear (a) and JLab Go Pods ANC — deliver better ANC while still offering good sound quality. So, if you can get one of those models at a similar price to the C3, you might get better bang for your buck.
Tribit FlyBuds C3 review: price & release date
- Priced at $39.99 / £49.99 (about AU$60)
- Released in September 2026
The Tribit FlyBuds C3 were released in September 2026, about five years after their predecessor, the FlyBuds C2 hit the market. The C3 deviate from the C2 pretty drastically, offering a proper in-ear seal, as well as active noise cancellation capabilities.
With a list price of $39.99 / £49.99 (about AU$60), the Tribit FlyBuds C3 sit firmly in the budget category. Rivals include the CMF Buds Pro 2, the Earfun Air 2, and the Sony WF-C510.
Tribit FlyBuds C3 review: specs
| Drivers | 10mm dynamic | 
| Active noise cancellation | Yes | 
| Battery life | 5 hours (buds with ANC on); 8 hours (buds, with ANC off); up to 35 hours (with charging case) | 
| Weight | 4g (per bud) | 
| Connectivity | Bluetooth 6.0 | 
| Frequency range | 20Hz-20kHz | 
| Waterproofing | IP55 | 
Should I buy the Tribit FlyBuds C3?
| Attribute | Notes | Score | 
|---|---|---|
| Features | Great EQ options and solid call quality, but ANC and battery life underwhelm. | 3/5 | 
| Sound quality | Clear sound with deep bass, but not the most detailed and mids need tweaking. | 3.5/5 | 
| Design | A bit plasticky, but very compact and comfortable. | 4/5 | 
| Value | Cheap asking price with good overall quality, but some rivals offer more in terms of ANC. | 4/5 | 
Buy them if…
You want good sound at a low price
The Tribit FlyBuds C3 offer pretty good audio quality, with particularly impressive bass and articulate treble. With some tuning, they also offer pretty expressive sound in the mid-range, making them a very solid, affordable pick.
You want super-comfortable earbuds
I found the C3 to be very comfortable in use, and they come with multiple-sized eartips, helping you to get the perfect fit for long listening sessions.
Don’t buy them if…
You want great ANC
The ANC on the C3 is below average in my opinion, so if you want better noise-cancelling capabilities check out my recommendations in the ‘also consider’ section.
You’re looking for long-lasting battery life
The battery life on the FlyBuds C3 isn’t awful, but it’s certainly nothing special. Five hours per bud with ANC on is pretty unremarkable. The affordable CMF Buds 2 will give you 6.5 hours of battery life with ANC on, which is a considerable step up.
Tribit FlyBuds C3 review: also consider
| Header Cell - Column 0 | Tribit FlyBuds C3 | JLab Go Pods ANC | Nothing Ear (a) | 
|---|---|---|---|
| Price | $39.99 / £49.99 (about AU$60) | $36.99 / £29.99 / AU$69.95 | $99 / £99 (about AU$140) | 
| Drivers | 10mm dynamic | 10mm dynamic | 11mm custom | 
| Active noise cancellation | Yes | Yes | Yes | 
| Battery life | 5 hours (buds with ANC on); 8 hours (buds with ANC off); up to 35 hours (with charging case) | 7.5 hours (buds); 26 hours (with charging case) | 5.5 hours (buds with ANC on); 9.5 hours (buds with ANC off); up to 42.5 hours with charging case) | 
| Weight | 4g (per bud) | 4.2g (per bud) | 4.8g (per bud) | 
| Connectivity | Bluetooth 6.0 | Bluetooth 5.4 | Row 5 - Cell 3 | 
| Frequency range | 20Hz-20kHz | 20Hz-20kHz | 20Hz-20kHz | 
| Waterproofing | IP55 | IP55 | IP54 | 
JLab Go Pods ANC
The JLab Go Pods ANC are an exceptional value for money option, with solid ANC, a delightfully comfortable in-ear fit, and strong sound quality, marked by regimented bass and well-defined highs. Their battery life isn’t the best (that 7.5 hours figure is with ANC switched off), and they’re not the prettiest buds around, but all in all, we’re still big fans. Read our full JLab Go Pods ANC review.
Nothing Ear (a)
These buds may be a little old now, but as a result, you can often find them on sale for a relatively similar price to the FlyBuds C3. We love the Nothing Ear (a) for their spectacular sound quality, impressive ANC, and stylish looks, so why not give them a go? Read our full Nothing Ear (a) review.
How I tested the Tribit FlyBuds C3
- Spent two weeks testing
- Mainly streamed tracks using Tidal
- Used in the office and when out on walks
I spent two weeks testing the Tribit FlyBuds C3, taking them everywhere with me — to the office, on public transport, and on walks. Testing them out in a variety of environments helped me assess their ANC in full, as well as their transparency mode.
When listening to music, I mainly used the Tidal app on my Xiaomi 17 phone, but I also dipped into Spotify from time to time. As always, I commenced testing by sifting through the TechRadar reference playlist, which features tracks from a variety of genres, but I also listened to hours worth of tunes from my personal library.
More generally, I’ve spent years testing audio gear here at TechRadar, where I serve as a Senior Reviews Writer. I’ve tested all sorts of products, from wireless headphones like the Sonos Ace Ultra to Dolby Atmos sounders like the Marshall Heston 120, as well as a huge array of earbuds, including the wired Sennheiser IE 200 and wireless JBL Live Beam 4.
- Read TechRadar’s reviews guarantee
- First reviewed: November 2026
Harry is a Senior Reviews Writer for TechRadar. He reviews everything from party speakers to wall chargers and has a particular interest in the worlds of audio and gaming. Harry has a background in business tech journalism, particularly around the telecoms industry.

articles.title: Sabíamos que la misión DART cambió la trayectoria de Dimorphos. Lo que no sabíamos es que también cambió su forma
articles.text:
A finales de septiembre de 2022, la misión DART (Double Asteroid Redirection Test) hacía historia, curiosamente, estampándose contra un asteroide. El hito no estuvo en el impacto en sí sino en lograr con él desviar levemente la trayectoria de un asteroide, Dimorphos.
Lo esperado y lo inesperado. En los cuatro años transcurridos desde entonces, hemos ido aprendiendo nuevos detalles sobre los efectos del impacto de DART en el asteroide Dimorphos. Ahora sabemos, por ejemplo, que DART no solo logró desviar la trayectoria orbital de la roca espacial; también consiguió con su impacto hacer que la órbita del asteroide se deformara notablemente
Lo que sucedió. El asteroide, explicaba el equipo, tenía inicialmente una forma oblata, es decir, achatada en los polos, como la Tierra, “la forma de una hamburguesa”. Tras el impacto, Dimorphos pasó a tener una forma más bien prolata, alargada en los polos, como un balón de rugby.
“En su mayor parte, nuestras predicciones pre-impacto sobre cómo DART cambiaría la forma en la que Didymos y su luna Dimorphos se mueven en el espacio eran correctas,” explicaba en una nota de prensa Derek Richardson, quien lideró el análisis de los efectos de la sonda. “Pero hay algunos descubrimientos inesperados que ayudan a proveer de una mejor imagen sobre como los asteroides y otros pequeños cuerpos se forman y evolucionan a lo largo del tiempo.”
Dando tumbos. Según el equipo que analizó estos cambios orbitales, el impacto habría hecho que Dimorfos pasara de un estado de equilibrio con su asteroide principal Didymos semejante al que tiene nuestra Luna con la Tierra, a uno irregular. Es decir, Dimorfos daba siempre la misma cara a Didymos, al menos hasta que llegó DART.
Ahora el sistema está fuera de su alineación, señalaba Richardson. Esto implica que puede tambalearse cambiando de orientación, incluso acabar “dando tumbos”, rotando de forma caótica e impredecible.
Formación de asteroides. Gracias a estudios como el realizado por Richardson y el equipo, podemos acceder a nuevas pistas sobre la formación de asteroides. Según explicaba el equipo, el impacto liberó pequeñas rocas que quedaron en la órbita del sistema de asteroides. Estas contribuyeron a alterar el movimiento orbital en el sistema, pero estos cambios en el equilibrio gravitatorio no parecen haber alterado la forma de Didymos.
Esto implica, añadía el equipo, que el asteroide principal del sistema era lo suficientemente rígido y firme como para mantener su forma tras la formación de su luna Dimorfos. Los detalles del trabajo fueron publicados en un artículo en la revista Planetary Science Journal.
El turno de Hera. La comunidad científica cuenta ahora con nuevos ojos sobre el sistema Didymos, los de Hera, la misión de la Agencia Espacial Europea (ESA) destinada a hacer un seguimiento del sistema y recabar nuevos datos in situ.
Hera despegó en octubre de 2024 gracias a un Falcon 9, sobrevolando marte en marzo de 2025 y comenzando los frenados de aproximación en octubre de este año. La ESA publicó el pasado 5 de noviembre una foto cercana de Didymos, con Dimorphos medio oculto, y se espera que tengamos más imágenes para el 25 de noviembre.
Los datos compilados por Hera permitirán un análisis aún más exhaustivo del impacto de la misión DART. Esto a su vez será lo que nos otorgue pistas clave que nos permitan planear misiones que protejan nuestro planeta del choque de asteroides.

articles.title: League of Legends cambiará para siempre: Riot Games revela detalles de la nueva versión del juego para 2027
articles.text:
Riot Games confirmó los primeros detalles de la renovación más grande en la historia de League of Legends. La actualización, llamada New Dawn, fue presentada mediante un tráiler durante la final de Worlds 2026.
El adelanto llegó después de meses de expectativa. Riot había anunciado a comienzos de año el proyecto conocido como League Next, con la promesa de una renovación integral del juego y un cliente completamente nuevo, aunque hasta ahora la información sobre el alcance real de los cambios se mantuvo limitada.
Qué mostró el tráiler de New Dawn
El video durante la final de Worlds 2026 ofreció una primera mirada a la Grieta del Invocador rediseñada, con modificaciones en el pozo del dragón, en sectores de la jungla y en los accesos a las líneas. Según explicó la propia desarrolladora, se trata del cambio más profundo que recibe el mapa desde 2014, doce años después de su última gran actualización.
New Dawn, como su nombre lo indica, busca representar un nuevo comienzo para el videojuego de rol multijugador en línea más popular de la industria, que lleva más de 15 años en el mercado desde su lanzamiento en 2009.
El tráiler también mostró retoques en los campeones, tanto en su aspecto visual como en sus animaciones. Se pudo ver, por ejemplo, a Vayne utilizando su habilidad Pirueta para saltar un muro y a Blitzcrank con lo que parecía una versión más poderosa de su habilidad Puño de Poder.
Riot no precisó si esos ajustes responden únicamente a cambios estéticos o si también están vinculados al sistema de runas, uno de los apartados que la compañía ya anticipó que modificará en 2027.
Cuáles son los cambios confirmados en jugabilidad y cliente
Entre las novedades ya confirmadas figura un cliente de juego nuevo y modernizado, pensado para resolver los problemas que arrastra la versión actual y que afectan a buena parte de los usuarios. Riot no detalló todavía qué funciones incluirá ni de qué manera se implementará su despliegue.
La compañía también adelantó que habrá cambios en la jugabilidad asociados a la actualización visual, además de modificaciones en las runas y en otros sistemas previos al inicio de las partidas. Según había señalado anteriormente Riot Meddler, miembro de la desarrolladora, League Next renovaría por completo el rol de soporte.
En el plano gráfico, el motor del juego recibió una mejora general: los colores aparecen más saturados, las partículas de los hechizos ganaron espectacularidad y las texturas del suelo, el agua y el decorado de la Grieta del Invocador fueron renovadas. Los modelos de los minions también cambiaron y ahora se muestran con mayor tamaño en las calles del mapa.
A esto se suma el objetivo declarado de mejorar la experiencia para los jugadores nuevos, uno de los principales desafíos que enfrenta Riot, dado que en los últimos años el juego mantuvo una base de usuarios fiel pero con dificultades para sumar público adicional, una situación que repercutió en los resultados financieros de la compañía.
Cuándo llegará y qué pasará con el calendario competitivo
Riot confirmó que la revelación completa de New Dawn tendrá lugar en enero de 2027, instancia en la que se espera que la compañía detalle los cambios en jugabilidad, runas y el funcionamiento del nuevo cliente. El lanzamiento de la actualización, en cambio, no ocurrirá a comienzos de año, sino más adelante en 2027, sin una fecha exacta todavía.
La nueva versión también tendrá efecto sobre el calendario competitivo. Riot prepara First Stand 2027 como el torneo más grande de la historia de League of Legends, con más equipos que en cualquier competición anterior del juego. Los participantes de First Stand All In disputarán ese torneo ya bajo la nueva versión, aunque no se precisó cuántos equipos participarán ni qué reglas concretas regirán la competencia.
A esto se añade la posibilidad de un nuevo modo de control con teclado y mouse estándar (WASD) y un eventual desembarco del juego en consolas, dos aspectos que, de confirmarse, implicarían una expansión de las plataformas en las que League of Legends puede jugarse.

articles.title: NVIDIA subit des pressions pour réintégrer Jensen Huang
articles.text:
Trois jours après avoir quitté NVIDIA, Jensen Huang évoque avec ses proches un retour à la tête du géant des puces, selon le Financial Times. Et ses alliés de la Silicon Valley montent une « cellule de crise » pour convaincre le conseil d’administration de le reprendre.
Encore un rebondissement qu'on n'avait pas vu venir. Jensen Huang a démissionné de la direction de Nvidia, l’entreprise de 4 000 milliards de dollars qu’il avait cofondée en 1993. Son conseil d’administration avait ouvert une enquête après la révélation de sa liaison avec Alice Huang, ancienne dirigeante de Megaspeed, société singapourienne cliente de NVIDIA, que le renseignement américain soupçonne d’espionner pour Pékin. Les administrateurs l’ont poussé vers la sortie après la découverte d’une seconde liaison, avec une subordonnée. D’après le Financial Times, l’ancien patron soutient la campagne lancée pour son retour. Mais contrairement à d’autres fondateurs de la Silicon Valley, Jensen Huang n’a jamais détenu le contrôle du capital de NVIDIA, et il ne pourra revenir que si son conseil d’administration accepte de le réintégrer.
Des milliers de salariés de NVIDIA réclament le retour de Jensen Huang
Sur « Stand with Jensen », un site de soutien à l’ancien P.-D.G, une pétition adressée au conseil de NVIDIA a recueilli 156 850 signatures. Plus de 7 500 salariés de l’entreprise l’ont signée, et plusieurs d’entre eux réclament publiquement son retour depuis sa démission. Elon Musk, prêt à embaucher Jensen Huang quand le conseil délibérait encore sur son sort, et Tim Sweeney, patron d’Epic Games, ont ajouté leur nom à la liste.
Deux gros actionnaires de NVIDIA mènent aussi la charge. Brad Gerstner, fondateur du fonds Altimeter Capital, et Gavin Baker, patron d’Atreides Management, ont écrit au conseil pour lui demander de laisser « toutes les options sur la table, y compris le retour potentiel de Jensen Huang ». Les deux investisseurs invoquent « le succès extraordinaire » de son long mandat, et l’incertitude provoquée par son départ.
Dans les coulisses, des dirigeants de la Silicon Valley se réunissent pour faire pression sur le conseil, comptent demander l’appui de la Maison Blanche. Comme l’explique un proche, « tous les acteurs importants du secteur technologique, en dehors des laboratoires d’IA de pointe, adorent Jensen ».
Le conseil de NVIDIA a approché le patron d’Arm
À Washington, le secrétaire au Trésor, Scott Bessent, a réclamé un « remaniement radical » de la direction de NVIDIA après le départ de Jensen Huang. Et Colette Kress, directrice financière devenue PDG par intérim, cherche avant tout à stabiliser l’entreprise avant la publication de ses résultats trimestriels, le 17 novembre.
Selon le Financial Times, le conseil d’administration a approché Rene Haas, le patron d’Arm, en vue de la succession de Jensen Huang, mais les administrateurs assurent qu’aucune procédure formelle n’a été engagée.
L’enquête indépendante sur ses agissements se poursuit. Depuis la révélation de sa liaison avec Alice Huang, les contrôles de NVIDIA avant la vente de ses puces d’IA à des clients asiatiques liés à la Chine sont examinés de plus près. Et les alliés de Jensen Huang peinent à redorer son image. « Avoir une liaison avec une subordonnée est un motif de licenciement », reconnaît l’une des personnes engagées dans la campagne pour son retour.

articles.title: Gamers might hate AI and the GPU pricing crisis it has caused — but some are now hooked on DLSS 5, and maybe that shows what Nvidia is angling at here
articles.text:
'It's a new world and I'm loving it': Some gamers are now hooked on DLSS 5 and can't game without it — and I think this shows Nvidia's escape plan in the GPU crisis
DLSS 5 on versus the tech being off is like comparing 60fps versus 30fps, according to one gamer
Things are happening real fast in the gaming world ever since AI began advancing at a rapid pace throughout this year. Emulation is taking huge strides for one thing, and on the PC front, DLSS 5 has made a big splash. Although as you may recall, when Nvidia debuted the feature, it was almost universally shot down.
But from the flames of what appeared to be a complete PR wreckage with that initial reveal, DLSS 5 has emerged as a graphical phoenix. The turnaround in opinion was slow at first, but sentiment has shifted notably since NBA 2K27 showcased the tech to great effect, and now there are comments appearing on Reddit indicating that 'wow' moments are happening. 'I can't live without this' moments, in fact.
A new normal
This thread illustrates what I mean, in which the original poster wrote: "I'm getting too used to DLSS 5 graphics. WOW factor is fading out. Turning it off looks flat like low graphics settings. It's just my new normal. How spoiled am I?"
Okay, so the Redditor is also observing that said 'wow' factor is fading, but in the respect that it's a new normal — and going back to non-DLSS 5 visuals now feels horrible.
A replying Redditor agreed: "Spoiled. Every game feels like a remaster and indeed ultra settings with DLSS 5 off feel like the new low settings. It's a new world and I'm loving it."
Someone else chipped in: "It really feels that way and especially NPC faces. With DLSS 5 they get very natural looking skin and shadows in the right places and with it off, the face returns to a pale, shadowless, clay sculpture. It's jarring".
Want another? This gamer said: "Cyberpunk 2077 was the real eye opener for me. I crashed my game by installing a couple hundred mods. When I got it back again, I spent an hour frustrated trying to figure out why everybody looked so fake and plastic and cartoony. Turns out, ReShade had just stopped running in the background, and DLSS 5 had turned off."
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
There are lots of observations like this, including that playing with DLSS 5 for a while and then going back to normal graphics is equivalent to getting used to 60fps (frames per second) gaming, and then having to return to 30fps. Some people feel that strongly about what they're getting here.
In case of any confusion, I should make it clear that these are gamers who are fudging DLSS 5 to work with unsupported games using various tools (and running it with older-gen Nvidia GPUs for that matter — it's only officially supported by RTX 5000 models). And yes, there's a definite caveat with this approach in that you need to be careful about how you're implementing the tech (there are various settings to adjust, and it's quite possible to go too over-the-top).
Even the most obvious drawback — the performance hit with DLSS 5 — is not ruining the graphical glow-up for gamers here, although admittedly it helps that the most pronounced benefits are being witnessed in older games (where base frame rates are a lot higher in general, with more headroom to take a hit, especially with a decent contemporary GPU). Nvidia is improving performance at a rate of knots, too, and the early honing work on DLSS 5 has been impressive indeed.
GPU misery
It's interesting to see just how much DLSS 5 is now swaying gamers who are experimenting with the tech, and I'll bet that while all this is an unofficial use of Nvidia's neural rendering trickery, Team Green is pleased to see this feedback in the midst of GPU price hikes rapidly reaching fresh and frightening peaks. (Not to mention that any good news will be welcome given the blow the company has suffered this week with the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang, but that's another story — albeit one I think gamers should very much take note of).
Lately, we've seen the RTX 5080 and RTX 5070 Ti spiral upwards in cost (along with other unpleasant increases down the GeForce range), and with further price rises pretty much inevitable — which are predicted to be potentially huge — the mentioned GPUs could end up something like triple their MSRPs in some countries by the end of the year. It really isn't a pleasant thought, and apparently Nvidia has cancelled the rumored RTX 5080 Super according to fresh gossip this week.
That leaves the top-end of the GeForce GPU range as very much a high-and-dry place, with the RTX 5090 having more or less disappeared, the RTX 5080 now priced out of reach of everyone but the rich PC enthusiast, and the theorized additional graphics card not coming anymore. (If it ever was, although there have been plenty of rumors about the Super refresh that it's believable enough this was in Nvidia's plans at some point).
I don't think the GPU world has looked as bleak for a long time (AMD's Radeon graphics cards are afflicted by their own nasty hikes, too, with the company now thinking very much like Nvidia). So, what am I driving at here? A theory that Nvidia is pushing so hard with DLSS 5 because the company knows that it's vital given the RAM crisis and GPU price spikes, which I feel are going to become even more ludicrous next year.
To go back to the Reddit thread I linked to above, another gamer observed: "We are all spoiled now. Just in time for all the hardware to evaporate."
That's the hammer hitting the nail square-on as far as I'm concerned, but I think that Nvidia feels able to let the consumer side of its GPU hardware business slide more (with all those AI data center profits to be reaped), because it expects the software side to pick up the slack to an extent.
If the performance tuning of DLSS 5 continues — which, of course, it will, and we'll surely see more big leaps in performance next year — the tech should be able to pep up lower-tier RTX 5000 GPUs quite nicely. In other words, the graphics cards which should remain in stock without a price tag that blows a ridiculous hole in your wallet (although I expect further pricing pain even at the budget-friendly end of the spectrum, make no mistake).
Okay, so it's true enough that diminishing returns are bound to kick in when the lower-hanging fruit for the honing and optimization of DLSS 5 is all picked, but I don't think that'll start to happen for some time yet. And don't forget that Nvidia is bringing support to RTX 4000 GPUs next year (I'm guessing sooner rather than later) to broaden the scope and effect of this technology considerably (though as noted, gamers are already doing this via workarounds).
An ironic escape route
With DLSS 5 quickly gaining more acceptance — and some gamers seemingly not able to play without it, even at this stage (with others going to great lengths to get it working with a PS5 for GTA 6, even) — it makes some sense that Nvidia is putting a lot of eggs in the neural rendering basket. Given how all this is unfolding, DLSS 5 might be Team Green's contingency plan if the GPU crisis becomes even more unbearable next year, tiding things over with software until the hardware situation improves.
Which ironically would mean that AI could be Nvidia's savior for the graphics card supply problems that were caused by AI in the first place (when it vacuumed up data center GPUs).
Remember that the original DLSS, when it was just upscaling, was not well-received when it first launched — and now look at it. I think DLSS 5 will likely go the same way, and indeed arguably it already has in the PC modding scene — at a breakneck pace — and I don't think it's a stretch to say it's likely going to be critical for Nvidia in the future, and especially next year.
